digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate run summary and LLM step failure observability
propositions: Repeated non-fatal LLM step failures during plan-review runs are invisible to callers because swallow sites log warnings only and no verdict counter exists for survived failures.
An overlap-judge batch that fails on every batch (~310s each) is byte-identical to one with no overlaps found, making three identical abstain results indistinguishable from actual zero-overlap state.
The plan-review verdict JSON lacks a counter for survived failures; coverage.resolution_class fires only on fatal degrade and coverage.chunk_errors is write-only with no reader.
All failed LLM calls funnel through one seam (PydanticAIRunner.run except block at runner.py:573) which writes a JSONL spend row but nothing in-memory to the verdict.

A new contextvars-based run-scoped sink must record LLM step failures at the runner seam and drain them into coverage.llm_step_failures only when non-empty, preserving attestation safety for clean runs.

The failure counter must be present only in plan-review verdicts when non-empty, keyed by the step's _call_label, without altering verdict string, exit code, signature, or swallow behaviour of any existing site.
